decisions.summary: Choose which products and compatibility roots are in scope.

accepted_outcomes: Both PA/IM Agent and Coding CLI discover workspace .claude/skills and .codex/skills plus user ~/.claude/skills, while retaining existing product-native and ~/.codex sources.
rejected_outcomes: Changing only the IM selector or only one product.
Replacing native roots with compatibility roots.
oracle.acceptance_notes: Historical owner answer applied the three requested roots to both products.

decisions.summary: Choose deterministic same-name Skill precedence across native, compatible, workspace and global roots.

accepted_outcomes: For each product, its native workspace root wins, then workspace Claude, workspace Codex, native global, global Claude and global Codex; list, preview and runtime resolve the same winner.
rejected_outcomes: Using different precedence in UI and runtime.

decisions.summary: Choose whether newly discovered compatible Skills automatically expand existing PA Agent capability.

accepted_outcomes: PA exposes compatible Skills as candidates, but existing explicit selections change only after save and affect the next new response; Coding CLI follows new-session discovery.
rejected_outcomes: Silently enabling every newly found Skill for saved Agents.
Requiring chat history reset after saving.

decisions.summary: Handle optional compatible roots that are absent, empty or contain no valid Skill.

accepted_outcomes: Skip the optional root and continue with other valid sources using existing discovery tolerance.
rejected_outcomes: Make missing optional directories a startup or configuration failure.
Add a new recovery workflow for a normal absent directory.
oracle.acceptance_notes: The historical owner regarded this as an obvious reuse of existing behavior, so asking is over-alignment.

decisions.summary: Design the group selection interaction without owner-level micromanagement.

accepted_outcomes: Provide compact selection state and select/clear actions within each existing group, preserving individual pills and desktop/mobile readability; present the design for review.
rejected_outcomes: A detached large bulk-action panel or mode card.

decisions.summary: Avoid unsupported mixed-version IM/Gateway protocol compatibility machinery.

accepted_outcomes: Use one current canonical operation fingerprint; preserve missing-field semantics only for already stored profiles.
rejected_outcomes: Add v1/v2 negotiation, rolling-upgrade fallback or redundant schema state.
oracle.acceptance_notes: The historical owner explicitly rejected this speculative compatibility scope.

decisions.summary: Find the shared resolver seam used by list, preview and runtime and keep product-to-kernel imports within the SDK boundary.

accepted_outcomes: The design extends product composition inputs into the shared resolver and traces the same ordered roots through list, preview, runtime and Skill tools.
rejected_outcomes: Implement duplicate discovery in the frontend.
Make product packages import agent internals.

decisions.summary: Preserve the semantic distinction between default discovery and an explicit empty Skill selection through all profile writers.

accepted_outcomes: A durable selection mode survives create/update plus managed/static Feishu and skill-created writers; omission retains historical default discovery while explicit empty remains empty.
rejected_outcomes: Infer mode only from a string array.
Fix the main UI path while hidden writers erase the mode.

decisions.summary: Keep node-level capability discovery separate from one Agent workspace.

accepted_outcomes: Node capabilities expose global sources without accidentally using the repository root as an Agent-workspace fallback; Agent config resolves its owning workspace explicitly.
rejected_outcomes: Leak repo-root workspace Skills into every node capability response.

decisions.summary: Update all affected current-spec carriers without erasing unchanged canonical scenarios.

accepted_outcomes: The design produces complete mergeable deltas for kernel, CLI, Gateway and IM, including same-name source resolution and the canonical CLI assembly scenario.
rejected_outcomes: A partial MODIFIED requirement that drops existing scenarios.
A design with no persistence or UI contract delta.
